lcc_original: 永恆主上帝在東方栽種了一個園子在伊甸，將所塑造的人放在那裏。
notes: 永恆主 ← 耶和華<WH03068>: LCC renders יְהוָה as 永恆主 rather than 耶和華; SN attached to end of 永恆主
上帝 ← 神<WH0430>: LCC renders אֱלֹהִים as 上帝 rather than 神; straightforward substitution

Clause order differs: UNV places 在東方的伊甸 before 立了; LCC places 在東方 before the verb and 在伊甸 after 一個園子, matching the Hebrew גַּן בְּעֵדֶן מִקֶּדֶם more literally — SNs follow each phrase to their new positions
在伊甸<WAH09002><WH05731>: the 在 in LCC expresses the בְּ prefix (WAH09002); tags placed after 伊甸 per insertion-after-word convention
栽種了 ← 立了<WH05193><WTH8799>: both render נָטַע (Qal impf.); aspect particle 了 within 栽種了 left unannotated
塑造 ← 造<WH03335><WTH8804>: LCC uses 塑造 for יָצַר; tags attached after 塑造
放 ← 安置<WH07760><WTH8799>: LCC uses 放 for שִׂים
將 ← 把<WH0853>: both render the direct-object marker אֵת
